stateDomains.stateFields: canonical : ObjKey -> destination/copy-task; copyReady : ObjKey -> Bool
stateDomains.invariant: One winning destination per admitted old object; strong-to-weak admission retains identity

stateDomains.stateFields: attempt : AttemptId -> Open/Settled; canonicalWinner : optional ObjKey
stateDomains.invariant: Losing speculative attempt can settle without settling or reminting canonical work

stateDomains.stateFields: copy : CopyTaskId -> Copying/Initialized/Settled; owner and publication children
stateDomains.invariant: Forwarding does not imply readiness; copy settles only with accepted required fragment custody

stateDomains.stateFields: fragment : Preparing/Scanning/Settled; role Body/Tail/Root/Frame/Still; assignedEdges; visitComplete
stateDomains.invariant: Body fragment settlement does not close tail fragment or whole object; no wait-for-child completion
Two slots may reuse one canonical target; each has its own exactly-once coverage receipt
Physical layout partition and semantic edge partition are different axes; descriptor reads may overlap

stateDomains.stateFields: issued; unfinished; settled; producer rights; unknown transfers
stateDomains.invariant: Typed attempt/copy/fragment/transfer tasks have unique ownership; edges are obligations contained by live fragments

actionContracts.guard: Copy Initialized; required Body/Tail fragments accepted with live or settled custody; publication/local handling known; no unknown copy effect
actionContracts.updateRule: Only the copy task -> Settled; canonical identity and copyReady remain valid
actionContracts.accounting: Settle exactly one copy task; Body/Tail fragments and source-edge receipts retain their own debts
actionContracts.frameRule: No whole-object closure and no requirement that accepted fragments already finish

actionContracts.guard: Parent Scanning; edge Resolving; matching canonical target and exclusively owned live source slot; write disposition known
actionContracts.updateRule: Redirect this slot to canonical destination and record referenceUpdate receipt; edge remains Resolving
actionContracts.accounting: No task creation or settlement; canonical readiness and parent debt unchanged
actionContracts.frameRule: Only the exact owned slot and its update receipt change; unknown effect remains unresolved

actionContracts.guard: Live copy custodian; admitted subtype/length and role descriptor known; before publication
actionContracts.updateRule: Enroll Body and applicable Tail fragments in Preparing; bind immutable assigned-edge inventories
actionContracts.accounting: Mint each required fragment once while copy task and producer remain live
actionContracts.frameRule: No field read, queue visibility or fragment settlement from reservation alone

actionContracts.guard: Preparing local/Tail fragment; relevant field/root inputs ready; descriptor/phase and counted owner match
actionContracts.updateRule: Fragment -> Scanning; retain all Unseen/Resolving edge obligations
actionContracts.frameRule: No claim of whole-object closure; queued Body uses acquireBatch instead

actionContracts.guard: Parent Scanning; edge Unseen in sealed assigned inventory; matching phase/descriptor; slot owned
actionContracts.updateRule: Edge -> Resolving; bind sampled origin and resolver; parent stays Scanning
actionContracts.accounting: No canonical issue and no fragment settlement; edge debt remains contained in parent
actionContracts.frameRule: Do not change another edge, phase, queue or scanner

actionContracts.guard: Resolver admitted; target absent; native CAS wins; old-header interpretation and origin stable
actionContracts.updateRule: Insert one canonical destination and live copy custodian; readiness false
actionContracts.accounting: Mint one copy task; if attempt exists settle only that attempt with separate ledger deltas
actionContracts.frameRule: Source edge can remain Resolving; no body-read admission from CAS alone

actionContracts.guard: Known losing CAS or known pre-effect rejection; matching AttemptId and live required-edge custodian
actionContracts.updateRule: Settle only speculative attempt; alias winning ObjKey when known
actionContracts.accounting: No canonical decrement and no assumed padding/storage refund
actionContracts.frameRule: No change to winner readiness, queue entry, assigned edges or fragment completion

actionContracts.guard: Parent Scanning; edge Resolving; canonical identity/custody or imported closure valid; reference update known; no unknown acceptance
actionContracts.updateRule: Edge -> Covered with target receipt; parent remains Scanning
actionContracts.accounting: No new canonical task and no parent settlement; child may remain Copying/Queued/Scanning
actionContracts.frameRule: Does not require target completion and does not mutate another slot receipt

actionContracts.guard: Parent Scanning; edge Resolving; target classified terminal by admitted descriptor/runtime policy; slot handling known
actionContracts.accounting: No managed child task minted; policy proof covers any separately rooted nonmovable data
actionContracts.frameRule: Do not treat every permanent/still/frame/weak object as an immediate

actionContracts.guard: Same EdgeId, descriptor and scope; edge already Covered; receipt registry still live
actionContracts.updateRule: Read existing coverage receipt; no new discovery effect
actionContracts.accounting: All task and completion counts unchanged
actionContracts.frameRule: No late enqueue, second slot mutation or fabricated receipt

actionContracts.guard: Canonical winner has live copy custody; subtype/length valid; required bytes copied
actionContracts.updateRule: copy -> Initialized; copyReady true; reserved fragment inputs become initialized, without starting Tail traversal
actionContracts.accounting: No remint of reserved fragments; copy custody stays live until required publication/local acceptance
actionContracts.frameRule: Readiness does not imply outgoing edges Covered or whole-object completion

actionContracts.guard: Complete initialized object boundaries and layout manifest; all delegated tails owned; visibility cut qualified
actionContracts.updateRule: Move exact Body fragments to queued custody, or retain local ownership on current-scan branch
actionContracts.accounting: No canonical remint and no task settlement; tail fragment remains separate
actionContracts.frameRule: No queue token for current-scan bypass; markers/padding are not managed object tasks

actionContracts.guard: Matching queue entry and phase manifest; counted scanner owns removed region; readiness/visibility valid
actionContracts.updateRule: Body fragments -> Scanning under scanner custody; local path admits matching cursor fragments
actionContracts.accounting: Queue removal transfers debt without settling it
actionContracts.frameRule: No duplicate claim of same FragmentId; Tail fragments keep their own owners

actionContracts.guard: Parent Scanning; sealed assigned edges all Covered; physical visit done; no unknown transfers; scope/custodian match
actionContracts.accounting: Settle exactly one fragment; canonical children and other fragments retain their debts
actionContracts.frameRule: No requirement that children finish; no implication that object or phase is closed

actionContracts.guard: Prior phase receipt valid; participants and next seed/skip policy admitted
actionContracts.updateRule: Preserve collection canonical map; create only required next-phase seed/deferred fragment ledger
actionContracts.accounting: No recopy merely because phase changed; no clearing old unresolved work
actionContracts.frameRule: Imported closure requires descriptor/phase certificate; forwarding address alone is insufficient

actionContracts.guard: Root/descriptor/issuer census sealed; no live producer rights or unfinished task/transfer in this phase
actionContracts.updateRule: Publish stable phase receipt; retain collection and target-specific outstanding scopes
actionContracts.accounting: No hidden Unseen edge can survive in a settled fragment; no cancellation to force zero
actionContracts.frameRule: Weak admission and resource-release completion remain separate cuts

scenarios.history: Publish before copy progress ready; later acquire observes stale payload
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Preserve publicationSafe violation under equivalent omitted-readiness guard
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Existing fault 1 source is preserved; no fresh model execution

scenarios.history: Last active worker idles with private or scanning/delegated work still owned
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Preserve terminationSafe violation when lifetime guard is intentionally omitted
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Existing fault 2 source is preserved; extend projection to richer hidden domains

scenarios.history: Acquire leaves same fragment queued; second acquire scans it again
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Preserve duplicate acquisition violation per FragmentId, not total scans per physical object
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Existing fault 3 source preserved; Body and Tail are legitimate distinct fragments

scenarios.history: Participants arrive and next phase begins before prior debt drains
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Preserve badPhase/old-debt witness across phase admission
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Existing fault 4 source preserved; no resetting canonical map to hide it

scenarios.history: Two resolving slots target same old ObjKey and each mints a canonical copy
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Unique canonical identity/count invariant must fail in omitted-dedup control
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Hypothetical mutation, not an observed native duplicate-copy failure

scenarios.history: Body fragment settles and queue empties while Tail fragment remains Preparing/Scanning
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Object/phase closure must remain false; omitted tail census must retain a witness
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Source split motivates the scenario; no executed counterexample

scenarios.history: One target known but another assigned edge Unseen, or transfer result unknown
scenarios.requiredOutcome: finishParent disabled; weakening all-edge/unknown guard must expose lost custody
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Parent target-exists alone is not coverage of the sealed inventory

scenarios.history: Assigned edge set empty but cursor/object physical visit not complete
scenarios.requiredOutcome: finishParent disabled despite vacuous all-edge coverage
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Payload-free leaves still require admitted physical layout/cursor handling

scenarios.history: Reset canonical map at weak admission and reinterpret old origin as a fresh copy
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Identity-preserving phase projection must reject this reinterpretation
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Current QNT resets abstract work; not a claim native code recopies here

scenarios.history: Replay or new edge creates work after same-phase completion
scenarios.requiredOutcome: No same-phase enqueue; retain valid old custodian or reject unsupported stale origin
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Existing guarded CollectionContract rescan stays guarded; no withdrawn trace revival

scenarios.history: Self-edge and two source slots reuse one live canonical task; each slot covers independently
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Parents can settle with accepted unfinished children; no recursive completion wait
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Required positive control, not a new accepted run

scenarios.history: Child claimed, initialized and queued while parent retains another unresolved edge
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Child may progress; parent still Scanning until its assigned inventory closes
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Preserve native permitted ordering; do not repair by blocking discovery

scenarios.history: Weak seeds reuse strong canonical identities and introduce only phase-required new obligations
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Preserve canonical map and actual skip/deferred semantics without global rescan mandate
scenarios.evidenceBoundary: Finite two-phase model must gain an explicit phase/identity adapter

preservationCases.guardPremises: Admitted old-header writers, no ABA, stable collection key, one winner
preservationCases.establishedAfter: One canonical copy; loser only settles attempt; origin identity preserved

preservationCases.guardPremises: Sealed descriptor inventory, exclusive source slot, accepted canonical custody or valid closure
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Edge state progresses without settling parent or child; every Covered edge has a valid receipt

preservationCases.guardPremises: Matching immutable EdgeId/descriptor/scope and live receipt registry
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Idempotent read preserves every ledger and cannot reopen a phase

preservationCases.guardPremises: Exact object/padding/marker layout; initialized prefix; phase/subtype edge inventory
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Physical cover and Body/Tail edge cover both preserved; byte-view overlap is not duplicate edge ownership

preservationCases.guardPremises: Qualified profile visibility, exact region membership, counted scanner, all tails retained
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Work custody moves without losing scanner/tail obligations or reminting canonical tasks

preservationCases.guardPremises: All assigned edges Covered, physical visit done, zero unknown transfers, matching custodian
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Exactly one fragment settles; other object/child/tail obligations remain

preservationCases.guardPremises: Typed task identities are disjoint, creation/settlement unique, nonnegative finite ledger
preservationCases.establishedAfter: issued = settled + unfinished with explicit new/settled deltas; no arithmetic-as-native-atomicity claim

preservationCases.guardPremises: Complete root/issuer census, prior phase receipt, phase-specific skip/import certificates
preservationCases.establishedAfter: Canonical map stable across phases; old work cannot be erased or imported by forwarding alone

sourceFacts.fact: Still CAS establishes a local to-scan list custodian rather than movable copying
sourceFacts.limit: Different canonical/list adapter; not the movable tail partition

sourceFacts.fact: End marker and queued chunk link/tail publication differ from currently-scanned chunk bypass
sourceFacts.limit: Exact region membership and actual visibility profile remain unproved

sourceFacts.fact: Will/weak table slot selection depends on phase and flags, including intentionally weak fields
sourceFacts.limit: Skipped relation classification is not always deferred tracing work
